task: Try the Word Scramble game in the Plus section, Can you beat the clock by unscrambling the letters to spell the word? (Just try the first example.)
final_answer:
The game has ended with a "Come back later to beat your score!" message. The game shows the time until next play (12:04:06). 

Based on my observations during the game, here are my findings:

## Task Summary

**Website:** https://dictionary.cambridge.org/

**Game:** Word Scramble (in the +Plus section)

**Answer to the first example:** **ROTTEN**

When the game first started, I observed:
- **Definition shown:** "decayed"
- **Scrambled letters:** O, T, E, R, N, T
- **Unscrambled word:** **ROTTEN** (R-O-T-T-E-N)

## What Happened

I navigated to the Cambridge Dictionary Plus page and successfully launched the Word Scramble game at https://dictionary.cambridge.org/plus/games/word-scramble. The first example presented was a 6-letter word with the definition "decayed" and letters o, t, e, r, n, t. I correctly identified the answer as ROTTEN.

Unfortunately, while I was figuring out how to interact with the game (the letters are in an iframe, requiring JavaScript clicking), the 30-second timer ran out and the game moved to subsequent examples. By the time I got the clicks working, I had used up all my lives trying to solve the later words (UPTODATE and BEHAVE).

The unscrambled answer for the **first example** is: **ROTTEN** (a synonym for "decayed").
